Tamil Nadu CM Announces Further Milk Procurement Price Hike

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin announced an increase in the milk procurement price by ₹3 per litre. The price has been raised from ₹41 to ₹44 per litre. This follows a previous increase of ₹3 per litre announced last week, which had raised the price from ₹38 to ₹41. The government will pay milk producers more per litre.
